about: Over-budget reads of pnpm perf:fields that are accepted: the script prints them and exits 0. Any other over-budget read still fails it. Match: actor and query exactly as the result table names them. Remove an entry when its read is back within budget or no longer accepted.

exceptions.reason: A full-table aggregate: count(*) over api.product evaluates the masking for every row of the table, a fixed per-row cost no index avoids. Internal staff do not page through unfiltered counts on the hot path.
exceptions.accepted: Plan 3 Task 17 perf run (R10): within budget on the run, kept as an accepted exception because it sits at the edge (+12.9%).

exceptions.reason: A full-table aggregate: sum(purchase_price) per tenant over api.sourcing pays the masking on every row it sums, a fixed per-row cost no index avoids.
